page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the running head above it and the page number at top right. Below the text, after a gap, one italic prayer passage. Signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes. Show-through from the other side of the leaf runs down the left edge and is left out.

main_text.l: ronæ meæ Honore & Salute Populi conjunctaꝫ
queis sim uno forsan Verbo magis nociturus,
quàm quæcunque Belli mala: dum, ut paucis
indulgeatur, cunctos pessundem[?].
Revivifcent (Deo juvante) Leges noftræ,
& cum iis Subditorum Meorum obsequium
& amor, modò ne Meo Consensu sepeliantur
eo Probri & Injustitiæ Tumulo, qui à nonnul-
lorum violentia effoditur.
Si non aliàs hæc liceat redimere quàm Li-
bertatis meæ aut Mortis pretio, en Me ultro
paratum dependere.
Nulla fors Regi verè calamitosa, quæ se-
cum Animæ Ipsius & Populi & Posterorum
servitutem non trahit.
Cernent forsan futura sæcula in quod præ-
sens ultrò amat cæcutire: & ostendet Deus
aliquando Populo meo, Me pro Illis potiùs
optâsse, quàm cum Illis pati; etiamsi plane cons-
taret Me in eorum servitutem assentientem
posse in aliquam libertatem restituì, satius du-
co unum Regem vel de extremis periclitari,
quàm tot in Eos Tyrannos confirmare: quod
Deus avertat, quicquid de Me facturus est,
qui Me in solitudine meâ solum esse nosse finit.

l.i: gnus semper mecum es, cujus potior vita præsen-
tia est, & cui servire Libertas consummatissima.
Agnosce Me Famulum Tuum, nec jam querar

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Possible uncertainty: "pessundem" (printed as an ss-ligature form, read as pessundem; marked [?]). "conjunctaꝫ" uses the printed ꝫ ligature for -as. "Famulum" and the catchword "amissam" are read from the bottom line. The Greek running head is copied as printed. Show-through of mirrored text at the left edge is ignored.
